:::{#sol-step-length-range}

$\convrate(\steplen) < 1$ says that $\abs{1 - \steplen\,\eigval_i} < 1$ for every $i$,
which is $-1 < 1 - \steplen\,\eigval_i < 1$.
The right [inequality](proof-writing.qmd#def-inequality) holds for every $\steplen > 0$
because $\eigval_i > 0$.
The left inequality is $\steplen\,\eigval_i < 2$, that is, $\steplen < 2 / \eigval_i$.
All $p$ of these hold exactly when the one for the largest [eigenvalue](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue) holds,
since that one is the most restrictive:

$$
0 < \steplen < \frac{2}{\eigval_{\max}}.
$$

:::
